You know Mike Tyson's been smacked around a lot in his life, from fights to the media, to things that happen in his personal life and I truly believe that Mike Tyson is a great man that he stands for freedom And he wants to go ahead and help some help create something bigger than himself in his wealth and help change the lives of so many out there so Mike Tyson you know thank you for all that you do first of all and I will say that there's one thing that Mike Tyson should pay attention to because it's very exciting, that within the Bit Club network, which I am a part of, that we are actually launching Bitcoin..on top of our mining contracts, we're launching Bitcoin ATMs across the globe. And there's gonna be an income stream for the masses of partaking in this movement. So it would be very awesome to get this video into Mike Tyson's hands, so he can take a look at it and take a closer look at what TheBitclubNetwork is doing. So, anyways subscribe to my Youtube channel below and I also wanna send a special shout out to Julia Toriansky, who actually created this Bitcoin shirt. And I will put a link down below you can actually order one. Very high-quality as you can see but, I think we all need to go ahead and represent and get the word out there about Bitcoin. Whether it's posting on your Facebook wall wearing cool clothing regarding Bitcoin or anything like that. So, be looking for a Bitcoin ATM near you and potentially it's gonna be Mike Tyson's, potentially it's very well going to be Bit Club Network's it'd be a match made in heaven to go ahead and introduce Mike Tyson into the Bit Club Network. Thank you and talk soon.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes Bit Club Network's mining contracts while claiming that participation will provide an income stream for the masses. He presents the opportunity enthusiastically, identifies himself as part of the network, and encourages broader exposure by urging that the video reach Mike Tyson and introduce him to Bit Club Network.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because the video links Bit Club Network mining contracts to recurring income and promotes participation in that mining-related opportunity. The content does not merely discuss Bitcoin mining as a technology; it advocates the network and its income-producing participation model.
